items.title: 6.7.1 Enthalpy tabdeeli aur calorie content ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.7.1, printed page 126.

blocks.text: Kisi khane ki enthalpy of combustion (ΔHc) ko jab kilocalories fi gram mein badal dein to wahi us khane ka calorie content hai.
Glucose se milne wali energy dekhiye:

Glucose ka calorie content aise nikalte hain: pehle glucose ke fi gram ΔH nikalein. Glucose ka molar mass 180 g mol⁻¹ hai. Upar wali equation batati hai ke 1 mol (180.0 g) glucose jalne par 2803 kJ energy nikalti hai.

blocks.text_alt: ΔH fi gram = –2803 kJ/mol ÷ 180 g/mol = –15.57 kJ/g

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ne fraction ke oopar '2803 kJ/g' likha hai; sahi unit kJ/mol hai. Phir kitab ne ΔH = –15.57 kJ/g ka manfi nishan chhor kar jawab '–3.72 kcal/g' likha hai. Sahi: calorie content = –(–15.57) ÷ 4.184 = +3.72 kcal/g. Calorie content hamesha musbat hota hai.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhein
blocks.text: Khane se li gai calories ko kaam, warzish (exercise) aur achhi sargarmiyon (positive activities) se barabar karna zaroori hai, warna jism ki nashonuma (growth) aur dekh bhaal mein adam-e-tawazun (imbalance) aa jata hai.

blocks.prompt: Ethanol ki enthalpy of combustion –1368 kJ mol⁻¹ hai (molar mass 46 g mol⁻¹). Is ka calorie content kcal/g mein kitna hai?
blocks.explanation: Fi gram: 1368 ÷ 46 = 29.7 kJ/g. Kilocalories mein: 29.7 ÷ 4.184 = 7.1 kcal/g, yani glucose se taqreeban double.

items: Calorie content (kcal/g) = fi gram heat of combustion ÷ 4.184 kJ/kcal.
Li gai calories aur kharch hone wali energy barabar honi chahiye.
